summary: ORBITAL LAB is an interactive educational Space Mission Design Game that allows users to create and explore their own space missions. Users can select mission destinations such as Earth Orbit, the Moon, and Mars, choose launch vehicles, propulsion systems, payloads, communication systems, power sources, and shielding options. The simulator evaluates mission readiness, estimated mass, budget, and mission performance. It also generates a mission timeline, flight event log, and mission report. Users can save their mission designs and export them as JSON files. The project aims to make space mission planning easier to understand through interactive learning and simulation.
details: ORBITAL LAB – Interactive Space Mission Design GymOrbital Lab is an interactive educational web platform designed to help students explore space missions and understand spacecraft design.The platform provides a virtual space mission design experience where users can learn about spacecraft systems, mission planning, orbital concepts, and space exploration.Our goal is to make complex space science concepts easier to understand through an interactive and user-friendly website.The project is designed to encourage students to explore STEM education, develop scientific thinking, and gain knowledge about space technology.Technology Used: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and NASA open data resources.NASA Data: The project aims to use publicly available NASA data resources to support space science learning and mission exploration.Impact: Making space science education accessible, interactive, and engaging for students around the world.
